title: Method, apparatus and computer program

pse.problem: Limitation in securely managing authorization for federated learning operations across multiple user equipments in a wireless communication system
pse.solution_function: The apparatus performs the following functions: receives an authorization request, determines user equipment authorization status, generates encryption keys, creates session identities, and manages records for authorized federated learning operations. It also handles confirmation messages from user equipments.
pse.solution_structure: The apparatus includes components for receiving/transmitting data, determining authorization status, generating encryption keys, creating session identities, managing records, and handling confirmations.
pse.solution_implementation: Upon receiving an authorization request, the apparatus queries subscription data to determine user equipment eligibility. If multiple user equipments are eligible, it generates encryption keys, creates session identities, and creates records for the federated learning operation. It then sends messages containing these details to the authorized user equipments. Upon receiving confirmation messages, it verifies successful message reception and provides this information to the server.
pse.effect: The solution enhances security by providing encrypted communication keys for federated learning operations, facilitates the management of multiple user equipments in a wireless communication system, and ensures secure exchange of session and identity information.
